interface.name: dotfiles_overview_v1

description.summary: desktop overview placement and window actions

interface.description: Companion to ext-foreign-toplevel-list and ext-image-copy-capture. Identifiers are those from ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.identifier. Each refresh produces a complete workspace/window snapshot followed by done. Window events follow desktop stacking order, bottom to top. Indices are zero-based and valid until the next snapshot.

request.name: begin_previews

description.summary: replace compositor previews on the next surface commit

request.description: The surface must belong to this client and have the desktop-overview layer role. Subsequent preview requests build a replacement layout, applied atomically with its next wl_surface commit. Passing null removes this resource's previews. Destroying the resource also removes them.

request.name: preview

description.summary: append a live window to the pending layout

request.description: Rectangles contains nine native-endian signed 24.8 values: destination x, y, width, height, then clip x, y, width, height, then opacity (0 to 1). Coordinates are local to the overview surface. Entries are ordered bottom to top. Window content is clipped to its XDG geometry and the supplied clip rectangle. At most 512 entries are accepted per layout.
